description: Flights on record leaving, on its local today, an airport whose own departures board GADUIN reads, that are cancelled or late now (coverage on_record: not every flight). Late means departed, or published to depart, more than late_threshold_minutes plus the airport's taxi allowance after the schedule its board shows, and not yet landed; an airport with no measured allowance lists only cancellations. Each physical flight appears once under its operating flight number, with designators listing every number it is sold under, its airports, scheduled departure in UTC, status (cancelled or delayed), delay in minutes and a link to its flight page. Cancellations first, then the longest delay. total counts every such flight; the list holds at most the worst 1,000 (truncated says when total exceeds them) and returned is how many this answer holds (at most limit). partial means some covered airport could not be read, so its flights may be missing from the list and the total.

limit.description: Max flights to return, worst first (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
